highlights.headline: Celtics win big over Bucks at home
highlights.description: The Celtics get 30 from Jaylen Brown as they pick up a 28-point win against the Bucks.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NBA Highlight (Celtics win big over Bucks at home) 2026/02/01 ESHEET

headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown had 30 points and 13 rebounds, Anfernee Simons scored 27 points off the bench and the Boston Celtics coasted to a 107-79 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaylen Brown has 30 points, 13 rebounds as Celtics coast to 107-79 win over Bucks
